page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8te.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated compute resources and high-performance graphics processing. Powered by the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

The primary hardware highlight of the ecs.gn8te.8xlarge is its dual NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs, which deliver a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers for distributed tasks.

In terms of qualitative cost efficiency, the ecs.gn8te.8xlarge offers a balanced allocation of high-frequency Intel Xeon cores and modern Ada Lovelace GPU architecture. This resource density makes it highly suitable for workloads that require substantial GPU memory and compute power without the overhead of local storage arrays. The absence of bundled local storage represents a design tradeoff, requiring users to architect external storage solutions while optimizing compute and memory resource utilization.
This instance is well-suited for workloads such as deep learning inference, data science jobs, 3D rendering, and GPU-accelerated database operations.
